title: Shared Serverless for Asset Bundles (Beta)
body: With Shared Serverless for Asset Bundles, notebooks and files in the same bundle can share serverless compute and an environment defined in the bundle-root `pyproject.toml` file. Workspace admins can enable **Project-Scoped Shared Compute** on the [**Previews** page](/aws/en/admin/workspace-settings/manage-previews). See [Shared Serverless for Asset Bundles](/aws/en/compute/serverless/notebooks/shared-serverless#asset-bundles-serverless).
